visualCharacteristics: Collection heading on a dark ink band: small eyebrow label above a large white section title.
contentPattern: One cell: optional eyebrow paragraph followed by a heading (h2); a card-carousel follows in the same section.
usage: Use as the heading for an insights collection on the dark band, placed directly above a card-carousel.
reuseGuidance: Reuse once per collection with its own title, adding the first variant on the top collection of the band.
